admin.approved.title: Approved ({n})
admin.coordinator.attachHint: No coordinator attached. Attach one in Event settings to enable matching, talks, and group chat.
admin.coordinator.attachedManage: Attaching or swapping the coordinator is done here; running-event actions like recompute and billing live on the Administration tab.
admin.coordinator.attachedOk: Coordinator attached ✓ Matchmaking will begin as attendees are processed.
admin.coordinator.body: A coordinator is a service that transcribes intro videos and computes who should meet whom. Without one there are no matches, and invite links need your manual approval. Pick one below (or paste an npub). It can read event content but can never act as the event.
admin.coordinator.detach.consequence: Detaching rotates the event keys (past content stays as-is) and orphans coordinator-run chat administration. Matching stops until you attach another. This can't be undone for the current coordinator.
admin.coordinator.idle: · quiet: the coordinator only publishes when there's something to do
admin.coordinator.replace.body: Replacing rotates the event keys and re-grants the new coordinator; the old one loses access.
admin.coordinator.testFail: Couldn't reach the coordinator (no announcement or recent activity).
admin.coordinator.testOk: Coordinator reachable: announcement and activity found.
admin.coordinator.title: AI coordinator
admin.coordinator.unverified: Coordinators self-publish these listings; only attach one you trust. It can read event content.
admin.coorg.body: Add someone by their npub to share full organizer control: they can edit the event, approve attendees, and manage the coordinator. (Their keys are gift-wrapped to them; they'll get access next time they open the event.)
admin.coorg.title: Co-organizers
admin.enrollSelf.body: You created this event but aren't a participant yet. Join to appear in People, get matched, and (if group chat is on) be added to it. Being the organizer alone doesn't put you on the roster.
admin.enrollSelf.sent: Joined ✓. With a coordinator attached it adds you to People and the group chat within a few seconds. Refresh to check.
admin.enrollSelf.title: Join your own event
admin.error.enterNpub: Enter an npub or 64-char hex pubkey
admin.grant.step1: On the device you created the event with, open Admin → Co-organizers.
admin.grant.step2: Paste this npub and add it.
admin.grant.step3: Keep this page open. It unlocks here automatically once the grant arrives.
admin.grant.waiting: Checking for the grant every few seconds…
admin.grant.waitingSigner: Waiting for your signer to connect. Checking starts as soon as it does.
admin.inviteSheet.title: Invite sheet
admin.invites.body: Single-use links that auto-approve (with a coordinator). The code rides the URL fragment and never touches a server.
admin.invites.exportCodes.body: One row per code you just generated, each with its label. Match the label to the buyer in your own list. The app never sees email addresses.
admin.invites.exportCodes.title: Codes for mailing
admin.invites.exportCodes.unavailable: Nothing to export right now. Invite codes are single-use secrets that are never stored anywhere, so they can only be exported in the same session that created them. Generate a new batch above for anyone you still need to mail.
admin.invites.exportCodes.warning: The file contains live invite codes: anyone who gets a copy can join. Handle it like a list of passwords.
admin.invites.exportUsed.body: One row per code ever issued for this event, and whether it has been used. Needs no codes, so it works at any time: match it to your own list by label to see who still needs a reminder.
admin.invites.exportUsed.empty: No invite codes have been published for this event yet.
admin.invites.exportUsed.title: Who has joined
admin.invites.exports.intro: Two exports, with two very different lifetimes. The codes themselves only exist while this page is open (they are never saved, on your device or on a relay) so they can only be exported now. Who has joined is worked out from the invite list published for this event, so that one keeps working months later.
admin.invites.format.txt: Text: links only, one per line
admin.invites.shared.body: One code everyone can scan: put it on the opening slide and people join without waiting for approval. The link is the secret: knowing the event is not enough to get in.
admin.invites.shared.ephemeral: This code is only in this tab. It is never saved. Show or copy it before you close the page.
admin.invites.shared.forwardHint: Anyone who scans it can forward the link, so a shorter window is safer. Once it expires the code is not refused; latecomers simply land in the approval queue.
admin.invites.shared.title: Shared entry code (one QR for the room)
admin.invites.title: Invite codes
admin.invites.usedNote: Once a code is seen used it stays used. Old join requests eventually disappear from relays, so this can only ever count up. It will never wrongly tell you a code is still free.
admin.metadata.body: Edit the public event information. Existing event and invite links stay the same.
admin.metadata.title: Event details
admin.noEidKey.body: You hold this event's organizer role here, but not its signing key (E_id), so admin actions can't be published from this device. Open the event on the device where you created it, or restore that device's key backup, then come back.
admin.noEidKey.title: Organizer key not on this device
admin.notOrganizer.body: Organizer keys live on the device that created the event. They aren't derived from your login. To admin from here, have them granted to this device's npub:
admin.notOrganizer.title: You don't hold this event's organizer keys on this device.
admin.page.attendees.hint: A roster preview. Only members ever see it.
admin.page.body: Customize the event page: a menu of links (to posts or any URL) and the sections shown below the header. Members-only items are encrypted: visitors don't even see they exist.
admin.page.feeds.badNpub: That doesn't look like an npub.
admin.page.feeds.body: Fold long-form posts by another npub into this event's feed, your organization's own Nostr account, for example. Filter by hashtag and publication date.
admin.page.feeds.duplicate: That account is already on the list.
admin.page.feeds.relaysHint: Left empty, the event's own relays are used. If the account publishes somewhere else, name its relays here or nothing will show up.
admin.page.pickPost: …or pick one of the event's posts
admin.page.sections.body: What the event home shows, in order. Without any sections the default layout is used.
admin.page.title: Menu & layout
admin.people.intakeUnavailable: Intake details unavailable (their request predates the sync window). Controls still work.
admin.people.withdrew: Asked to leave. Their app has already removed their intro and media, so revoking here is what takes them off the roster.
admin.people.withdrew.purge: Asked to leave and to have their data deleted. Their app has already removed their intro and media, so revoking here is what takes them off the roster.
admin.person.copyIdFailed: Copying failed. Select and copy it by hand:
admin.person.noIntake: No submitted intake is available for this person.
admin.person.title: {name}: details
admin.poison.body: The coordinator gave up on “{stage}” after {attempts} attempts. An attendee may be missing a profile or matches.
admin.poison.title: Coordinator stuck on a job
admin.posts.body: Announcements and posts shown on the event page. Markdown works. Public posts are standard Nostr long-form under the event's identity; members-only posts are encrypted to approved attendees.
admin.posts.title: Event posts
admin.relays.body: The relays this event publishes to and is found on. Changing this only affects this event. Existing attendees keep working on the old relays until they refresh. New events use the app defaults automatically.
admin.relays.chat: Group chat also uses its own relays, kept separate because they accept chat messages only: {relays}
admin.relays.hint: One relay per line. Must start with wss:// (ws:// is allowed only for localhost).
admin.relays.title: Event relays
admin.reprocess.noIntake: No submitted details are reachable for this person right now, so there's nothing to re-publish. Try again after a refresh.
admin.requests.reject.confirm: Hide this request locally. The attendee isn't notified, and you can undo it below.
admin.requests.title: Join requests
admin.requests.withdrew: Asked to leave after sending this request. Approving now would re-admit them.
admin.requests.withdrew.purge: Asked to leave and to have their data deleted, after sending this request. Approving now would re-admit them.
admin.retention.body: Set how long member data is kept after the event ends. Leave blank to keep it indefinitely.
admin.retention.consequence: The directory, matches and talks are deleted from relays {n} days after the event ends. Deletion is best-effort.
admin.retention.consequenceOff: No automatic deletion: member data is kept indefinitely.
admin.retention.invalid: Enter a whole number of days (1 or more), or leave it blank for no deletion.
admin.retention.title: Delete member data after the event
admin.revoke.confirm: They lose access to everything new. What they already saw can't be taken back.
admin.settings.title: Event settings
admin.talks.body: Enable talks so attendees can submit and watch them. Off keeps the event as a normal meetup.
admin.talks.mod.body: Review each submitted talk, then publish it so attendees can watch, or reject it.
admin.talks.mod.needsCoordinator: Publishing talks needs a coordinator. Attach one above, then submitted talks can be published here.
admin.talks.mod.none: No talks are waiting for review.
admin.talks.mod.title: Pending talks
admin.talks.title: Prerecorded talks
admin.theme.body: Custom CSS for this event's pages (max 32 KB). It applies only while someone is viewing this event, never to the rest of the app.
admin.theme.title: Appearance
admin.title: Organizer admin
app.android.offlineCached: Offline. Showing what is saved on this phone.
app.android.updateHint: Updates arrive through Zapstore or wherever you installed the app from.
app.offline: Offline. You can still browse cached people and matches; changes will sync when you reconnect.
app.tagline: Meet the right people at events.
attendee.error.badNpub.body: This profile link isn't valid. Check the link and try again.
attendee.muted.title: You've muted this person
attendee.name: Attendee
attendees.asOf: Showing a saved list, as of {time}. No relay has answered since.
attendees.asOf.unknown: Showing a saved list. This device cannot tell how old it is.
attendees.empty.none: Nobody is on the list yet. People appear here as the organizer approves them; if you were just approved yourself, your own entry can take a minute to arrive.
attendees.empty.none.community: Nobody has introduced themselves here yet. Record yours and you will be told about everyone who arrives after you.
attendees.empty.notApproved: The attendee list is encrypted for approved attendees, and this device doesn't have the key yet. Join the event, or, if you were just approved, give it a moment and try again.
attendees.empty.staleKey: There are people here, but this device can't read the list. Your access key is out of date, which happens after the organizer removes someone. Try again in a moment; if it persists, ask the organizer whether you're still on the list.
attendees.empty.unreachable: Couldn't reach the relays that hold the attendee list, so we can't tell who's here. Venue Wi-Fi often blocks them. Try again, or switch networks.
attendees.filter.label: Filters
attendees.name: Attendee
attendees.noResults: No one matches your search and filters.
attendees.pane.hint: Pick somebody from the list to see their intro, what they do, and why the two of you should meet.
attendees.search.label: Search attendees
attendees.search.placeholder: Search by name, bio, or skill…
attendees.section.allFeatured: Everyone here is already listed above.
attendees.sinceLastVisit.many: {n} people have joined since you were last here.
attendees.sinceLastVisit.one: One person has joined since you were last here.
attendees.title: People
backup.copied: Copied ✓, now paste it into a Nostr app
backup.email.body: A one-tap link to get back in on any device. Note: email isn't fully private, so this trades a little privacy for convenience.
backup.email.title: Email a recovery link to yourself
backup.file.title: Password-protected file
backup.noKey: Your key lives in your signer. Back it up there. Nothing to export here.
backup.stage.confirmFailed: Couldn't record the backup marker, try again.
backup.stage.copied: Secret copied. Copying isn't a backup yet. Save it somewhere safe.
backup.warning.a: This is your private key. It's like your password:
backup.warning.b: , anyone who has it controls your account. To use another Nostr app, choose “log in with a key / nsec” there and paste this in.
boot.badRecoveryLink: That recovery link didn't carry a usable key. Ask for a fresh one, or sign in another way.
chat.android.startFailed: The chat couldn't start on this phone.
chat.android.steps.attest: Asked the coordinator to add this phone
chat.android.steps.attestFailed: Couldn't send the request to the coordinator. Check your signer, then try again.
chat.android.steps.attestQueued: The request to the coordinator is waiting for a connection
chat.android.steps.attestWaiting: Asking the coordinator to add this phone…
chat.android.steps.keyPackage: This phone's chat key is published
chat.android.steps.unverified: Invitation received. Waiting for the event's member list to confirm it is this event's chat.
chat.android.steps.welcome: Waiting for the coordinator to add you
chat.cmd.noSuchPerson: Nobody in this chat matches that name.
chat.cmd.willOpen: Enter opens a private conversation with {name}
chat.cmd.willSend: Enter sends a private message to {name} and opens it
chat.devices.actionFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection or signer and try again.
chat.devices.manage.body: Devices signed in to this event's chat with your account. Each has its own key and joins the group on its own. To add your phone or another browser, open this event there and sign in. Remove any you no longer use. History starts from when each device joins.
chat.devices.manage.title: Chat devices
chat.devices.none: No devices yet. Open this event's chat to add this one.
chat.devices.queued: Saved, but it hasn't reached a relay yet. It'll be sent when you're back online.
chat.devices.updated: Saved. The list updates once the coordinator processes it.
chat.disclosure.body: This chat is end-to-end encrypted (MLS/Marmot). The event coordinator operates and can read it, and each device sees only messages sent after it joined.
chat.display.label: Chat style
chat.evicted.body: New messages won't reach this device until you're added again. Everything above is what you received while you were in.
chat.evicted.title: You're no longer in this chat
chat.handoff.link.badNpub: Enter an npub or 64-char hex pubkey
chat.handoff.link.body: Already have an identity there? Paste its npub below to authorize it. It'll join this chat automatically, no key leaves this device.
chat.handoff.link.relaysHint: This event's relays, in case it still doesn't join:
chat.handoff.link.success: Authorized. Open it in that client: it'll join once its key package is found. If it hasn't after a few minutes, authorize again here to re-check.
chat.handoff.link.title: Use this chat in Whitenoise (or another Marmot client)
chat.members.attested: (registered devices, the room hasn't answered yet)
chat.members.title: In this chat
chat.otherTab.body: This event's chat is active in another tab or window. Use it there to send messages. The newest messages still show here.
chat.otherTab.title: Chat is open in another tab
chat.refused.boundElsewhere: The coordinator turned this device away: its chat key is already registered to a different account on this event. Clearing this site's data for this browser will mint a fresh device key.
chat.refused.deviceCap: The coordinator turned this device away: your account is already using the maximum number of chat devices for this event. Remove one under “Chat devices” below, then try again.
chat.refused.keyPackage: The coordinator couldn't use this device's encryption key. Ask to be added to this chat again to publish a fresh one.
chat.refused.other: The coordinator turned this device away. Ask to be added to this chat again, or check with the organizer.
chat.refused.proof: The coordinator couldn't verify that this device owns its chat key. Sign out and back in on this device, then open the chat again.
chat.rejoinFailed: Couldn't ask to rejoin. Check your connection and try again.
chat.rejoinHint: Still nothing after trying again? Ask to be added to this chat again.
chat.rejoinRequested: Asked to be added again. This usually takes under a minute. Your message stays in the box; send it once the chat is back.
chat.sendFailed: Couldn't send: this device is no longer in the chat. Ask to be added again.
chat.sendFailedTransport: Couldn't send: we couldn't reach the relays. Your message is still here, try again.
chat.setup: Setting up your secure chat… you'll join once the coordinator adds you.
chat.setupSlow: Still waiting to be added. The coordinator adds you to the group chat. If this doesn't clear, it may be offline; check with the organizer. You can keep waiting or try again.
chat.title: Group chat
chat.toggle.help: Adds an end-to-end-encrypted group chat for members. Requires a coordinator; the coordinator can read the chat.
chat.toggle.label: Group chat (Marmot)
chat.toggle.needsCoordinator: Add a coordinator to enable group chat.
chat.unavailable: Group chat isn't available for this event, or you're not a member yet.
chat.wn.body: Read and answer this chat in the White Noise app too. Enter the npub of your White Noise account. The coordinator adds it as one of your chat devices, and you can remove it here like any other.
chat.wn.expiry: The code is valid for 30 minutes.
chat.wn.failed: Couldn't send. Check your connection or signer and try again.
chat.wn.invalid: That isn't an npub, nprofile or 64-character hex key.
chat.wn.linkedBody: Invite sent to White Noise. Accept it there. You'll see messages from now on, not older ones.
chat.wn.refused.boundElsewhere: This White Noise account is already linked to a different account on this event.
chat.wn.refused.codeWrong: That code isn't right. Check it in White Noise and try again.
chat.wn.refused.deviceCap: You already have the maximum number of chat devices for this event. Remove one above, then try again.
chat.wn.refused.expired: The code expired. Start over to get a new one.
chat.wn.refused.failed: The coordinator couldn't send the invite to White Noise. Try again in a minute.
chat.wn.refused.keyPackage: The coordinator can't use this White Noise account's keys. Update White Noise to its latest version, open it once, and try again.
chat.wn.refused.noKeyPackage: The coordinator couldn't find this account on White Noise. Open White Noise once so it publishes its keys, check the npub, and try again.
chat.wn.refused.noPending: No link is waiting for this code. Start over.
chat.wn.refused.other: The coordinator turned the link down. Try again, or check with the organizer.
chat.wn.refused.rateLimited: Too many link attempts. Wait an hour, then try again.
chat.wn.refused.tooMany: Too many wrong codes. Start over to get a new one.
chat.wn.refused.unavailable: Chat isn't active for this event right now.
chat.wn.title: Also chat from White Noise or another Marmot client
chat.wn.waitingBody: Open White Noise, accept the invite “Nostrautica: confirm White Noise link”, and type the code shown there.
common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the text and copy it manually.
conn.relayBlocked: Connected to the internet, but no relay is reachable. This network may be blocking connections. Your changes are saved and will sync once a relay connects.
content.updateNeeded: Some of this was written by a newer version of Nostrautica. Update the app to see it.
create.backupOrganizer.body: This key controls your event. Don't lose it.
create.coordinator.body: Attach one now to enable matchmaking, talks, and instant invite-link approval from the moment your event goes live. You can also skip this and attach one later from the admin screen.
create.coordinator.invalidKey: That's not a valid coordinator npub or hex key.
create.coordinator.title: AI coordinator
create.duplicatedFrom: Starting from a copy of “{title}”. A brand-new event with fresh keys will be created.
create.enrollSelf.body: You'll appear in the People list like any attendee, so the first person who joins isn't alone. Your profile name and bio are visible to approved attendees only.
create.error.endBeforeStart: End time must be after the start time.
create.error.identityFailed: Couldn't create your identity, please retry.
create.error.loginToUpload: Log in (or create the event first) to upload images. Generated ones are used meanwhile.
create.error.startRequired: Please choose a start date and time.
create.error.titleRequired: Title and start time are required.
create.field.language.body: Sets the attendee interface and the language of AI match reasoning and profile summaries. Attendees can still write in any language.
create.field.talks.body: Let attendees submit talks that others can watch. Off keeps the event as a normal meetup.
create.field.title: Title
create.imageUrl.invalid: Enter a full https:// image address.
create.imageUrl.pickBanner: Use an image URL for the event banner
create.imageUrl.pickIcon: Use an image URL for the event icon
create.images.body: Generated from the title if you set neither. Uploads go to a public Blossom server (Primal); a pasted URL is stored as-is and nothing is uploaded, so the image has to stay online where it is.
create.kind.community.body: A standing group with no date and no end, like people who already share a chat somewhere. Anyone with the link is in, and matches keep arriving as more people introduce themselves.
create.kind.event.body: It happens on a date, in a place, and ends. People record an intro beforehand and arrive knowing who to look for.
create.organizerName.body: Your organizer identity is created with the event, no signup needed.
create.receipt.backup.pending.body: Back up your organizer key below: without it you can't recover admin access.
create.rotationNote: Note: key rotation is forward-only: anyone who ever held a decryption key can decrypt content published while it was current, forever (spec §4.2).
create.step.approve: Approve people as they ask to join
create.step.approve.body: Requests appear on the admin screen (invite links can skip this).
create.step.coordinator.attached.body: It starts building matches and processing intros within a few minutes. You can change or remove it later from the admin screen.
create.step.coordinator.body: Enables matchmaking and instant invite-link approval, done from the admin screen, or skip it and approve people yourself.
create.step.coordinator.failed.body: Your event was created, but publishing the coordinator grant failed. Retry here, or attach it later from the admin screen.
create.step.enroll.failed: Adding you to the roster didn't complete
create.step.enroll.failed.body: Your event was created, but enrolling you as a participant failed. Retry so People isn't empty for the first attendee.
create.talks.on: On: attendees can submit talks (Talks tab appears)
create.talks.prerecordFirst: Prerecord-first. Same, but Talks is the featured tab: the format is watch ahead, meet at the venue
create.title: Create an event or community

dmchat.e2e: End-to-end encrypted (NIP-17), also readable in other Nostr messengers.

event.install.iosHint: Tap the Share button in Safari, then “Add to Home Screen”.

event.ownStatus.talk: Your talk couldn't be processed. Try re-recording.

event.recordIntro.body: Matches come from intros. Record yours to show up in them.

event.recoverKeys.empty: No key backup for this event was found for this account.
event.recoverKeys.failed: Couldn't restore your keys. Check your connection or signer and try again.
event.recoverKeys.restored: Your organizer keys are back on this device.

home.addByLink.body.native: Invite and event links open in this app when you tap them. You can also paste one here.

join.waiting.checked: Last checked {time} · checking again every {sec} seconds.
join.waiting.invite: Waiting for auto-approval… If it doesn't arrive, the organizer will review your request manually.
join.waiting.manual: The organizer will review your request. You'll get access as soon as they approve.
join.whyIntro.intro: Optional, but recommended. It helps in a few ways:
join.whyIntro.matches: Better matches: the more you share, the more the matching has to work with.
join.whyIntro.recognize: Recognizing each other: a video intro means you'll actually recognize your matches when you spot them in the crowd.
join.whyIntro.vibe: A feel for who you'd click with: people can play your intro and see if you'd vibe together. Matching isn't just projects and skills, it's also a feeling AI can't capture on its own.
lang.label: Language
login.createSub: No email, no password: your account is created instantly.
login.created.body: A Nostr identity was just created for you. Back it up now so you never lose access.
login.title: Log in
logout.encryptFailed: Logout couldn't lock some of your keys on this device (your signer was unreachable), so they were left in place rather than risked. Log in again to finish securing them.
matches.noStrong: Nobody stands out sharply yet, so these are the closest. More people are still joining, and matches recalculate as they do.
matches.none: No matches yet. They appear once the coordinator has processed a few attendees. Check back soon.
matches.none.community: No matches yet. {n} of the people here have introduced themselves, and matches appear as more do.
matches.none.noIntro: No matches yet. The coordinator starts from your Nostr profile and posts, so check back in a few minutes. Recording an intro makes your matches much better.
matches.none.why: Matches appear once your intro has been processed and the organizer has run matching.
me.handle.body: Share this freely: it's how people find and follow you. (It's safe to post.)
me.keyInSigner: Your key lives in your signer. Back it up there.
me.logout.keyLoss.body: This app created your Nostr identity and the key lives only on this device. You haven't saved it anywhere yet. Logging out deletes it for good. Nobody can bring it back: your profile, the events you joined and your messages go with it.
me.logout.keyLoss.confirm: Log out and erase my key
me.logout.keyLoss.title: Logging out erases your key from this device
me.logout.warnUnsent.many: You have {n} unsent actions waiting to send. Logging out will discard them. They won't be published. Log out anyway?
me.logout.warnUnsent.one: You have {n} unsent action waiting to send. Logging out will discard it. It won't be published. Log out anyway?
me.new.body: You own a real Nostr identity: an account no company controls and no one can take away. Your profile and the people you followed travel with it into a whole ecosystem of apps.
me.takeAnywhere.body: These are independent Nostr apps, like different clients for the same account. Copy your key below, open one, choose “log in with a key”, and paste it in. Your profile and the people you followed are already there.
more.eventPrivacy.body: How this event handles matching and your data is explained on the join screen.
mute.confirm: Muted in Nostrautica and compatible Nostr clients; other clients may behave differently.
mute.unreadable: Your mute list was written by an older Nostr client using NIP-04 encryption, which this app can't read. Muting is disabled here rather than risk overwriting the list. Unmute everyone in that client, or clear the list there, and it will work again.
notfound.title: Not found

readiness.allSet: You're all set: matches are ready
readiness.hint.backup: Save your key so you don't lose your account.
readiness.hint.empty: Your profile is empty, so matching has nothing to go on and you won't appear in anyone's matches. A line about yourself or a few skills is enough.
readiness.hint.failed: The coordinator couldn't build your profile. Editing and saving it sends it again.
readiness.hint.failedMedia: Your recording couldn't be processed. Recording a new one usually fixes it.

readiness.hint.signerKey: Your key lives safely in your signer.

record.android.needsNetwork: Uploading needs an internet connection. Your recording stays on this phone, so send it when you're back online.
record.android.permission.camera: Recording needs the camera and microphone. Allow them when Android asks, or in Settings → Apps → Nostrautica → Permissions. You can also record audio or type your intro instead.
record.android.permission.mic: Recording needs the microphone. Allow it when Android asks, or in Settings → Apps → Nostrautica → Permissions. You can also type your intro instead.
record.android.takeRestored: Your unsent recording is still here.
record.audio.hint: Record a short spoken intro. No camera needed.
record.deviceError.absent.camera: No camera was found on this device. Try a device with a camera, or record audio or type your intro instead.
record.deviceError.absent.mic: No microphone was found on this device. Try another device, or type your intro instead.
record.deviceError.busy.camera: Your camera is in use by another app or tab. Close it and try again.
record.deviceError.busy.mic: Your microphone is in use by another app or tab. Close it and try again.
record.deviceError.denied.camera: Camera access was blocked. Allow camera + microphone for this site in your browser's address bar, then try again, or record audio or type your intro instead.
record.deviceError.denied.mic: Microphone access was blocked. Allow the microphone for this site in your browser's address bar, then try again, or type your intro instead.
record.deviceError.unknown.camera: Couldn't start the camera. Try again, or record audio or type your intro instead.
record.deviceError.unknown.mic: Couldn't start the microphone. Try again, or type your intro instead.
record.deviceError.unsupported.camera: Recording isn't supported in this browser. Try a recent Chrome, Safari, or Firefox, or type your intro instead.
record.deviceError.unsupported.mic: Recording isn't supported in this browser. Try a recent browser, or type your intro instead.
record.disclosure.attendees: Approved attendees of this event can view your intro.
record.disclosure.confirm: I understand the coordinator and its listed processing providers will process this intro.
record.disclosure.confirmNoCoord: I understand this intro is shared with this event's attendees.
record.disclosure.confirmText: I understand the coordinator and its AI provider will process this text to build my profile and matches.
record.disclosure.coordinator: The event's coordinator decrypts and processes it to build your profile and matches.
record.disclosure.providers: Its configured transcription and AI providers receive the audio, transcript, and profile text derived from your intro. The match model may run on a non-private provider tier.
record.disclosure.textProviders: Its configured AI provider receives your text to build your profile and matches. Nothing is recorded or transcribed. No audio leaves your device.
record.disclosure.title: Before you share this

signin.nip55.hint: Your key stays in {app}. Once you allow Nostrautica there, signing happens in the background.
signin.nip55.none: No signer app found on this phone. Amber is one; or use another option below.
signin.paste.invalid: That doesn't look like a key. Paste an nsec1…, ncryptsec1… or bunker:// link.
signin.paste.saferHint: On a shared device, a signer app or extension is safer than pasting your key.
signin.paste.tooStrong: This backup's encryption needs more memory than this phone gives an app. Unlock it in another app and paste the nsec instead.
signin.remote.authRequired: Your signer asks you to approve this request on its website:
signin.remote.hint: such as Amber, Amethyst or Clave
signin.remote.openSigner: Open in your signer app (Amber, Clave, Amethyst, …)
signin.remote.scan: Scan this with your signer app (on this device or on another phone) or open it directly here:
signin.remote.showQr: Show a QR code for a signer on another device
signin.remote.staleHint: Didn't get the approval? Keep this tab open while approving, or retry with a fresh code.
signin.remote.waiting: Waiting for the signer to approve…
signin.superseded: Another sign-in or sign-out on this device interrupted that one. Try again.
signin.trouble.bunker: Or go the other way: in your signer, create a connection, copy the bunker:// link it gives you, and paste that into "Paste a key" below.
signin.trouble.primal: Primal's built-in signer does not work here. It silently refuses the kinds of event Nostrautica publishes, so signing in looks like it worked and then nothing you do is saved. Use Amber on Android, Clave on iOS, or another NIP-46 signer.
signin.trouble.wrongApp: Opened the wrong app? With more than one signer installed, the button opens whichever one claimed the link, which is often not the one you want. Copy the code above, open the signer you want yourself, and paste it in there.
submit.error.invalid: Your profile couldn't be sent: {field} is {reason}. Fix it and save again. Nothing was lost.
